summary: Iteration 69 - Guest Profiles, Bookings Calendar, and Campaigns upgrades testing complete. Fixed critical bug in Guest Profiles (TypeError on preferences.includes). All features verified working.

bugs_fixed.issue: TypeError: ((intermediate value)(intermediate value)(intermediate value) || []).includes is not a function
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Backend GuestProfile model had preferences as dict and notes as string, but frontend expected preferences as array and notes as array of objects
fix_applied: Updated backend/models.py: Changed GuestProfile.preferences from dict to list, notes from str to list
Updated frontend GuestProfilesPanel.js: Added Array.isArray() checks for preferences and notes to handle both old and new data formats

Filter by tier dropdown (All Tiers, Standard, Silver, Gold, Platinum) ✓
Guest list shows name, tier badge, stays count, total spend ✓

Preferences dialog with 12 options (High Floor, Quiet Room, Extra Pillows, Late Checkout, Early Check-in, Vegan Diet, Halal Food, Non-Smoking, Pet-Friendly, Accessible Room, Empty Minibar, Daily Newspaper) ✓
Add Staff Note dialog with textarea and Save Note button ✓
Stay History showing booking refs, dates, amounts, payment status ✓
Calendar tab in Rooms & Bookings panel ✓
Day headers (MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN) ✓
Check-in indicators (green) showing count per day ✓
Check-out indicators (amber) showing count per day ✓
Staying indicators (blue) showing guests staying through ✓
Campaigns panel with header and stats (Total, Sent, Drafts, Recipients) ✓

Templates: Welcome Back (retention), Pre-Arrival (operations), Post Stay Review (feedback), Special Offer (promotion), Birthday Wishes (loyalty), Loyalty Tier Upgrade (loyalty) ✓

critical_code_review_comments: Guest Profiles panel has excellent split layout design with comprehensive guest detail view
Bookings Calendar provides clear visual indicators for check-ins, check-outs, and staying guests
Campaigns module is well-structured with Templates and Audience tabs for easy campaign creation
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest Profiles, Bookings Calendar, and Campaigns modules are fully functional. Guest Profiles requires clicking 'Sync from Bookings' to populate guest list if empty. Bookings Calendar is the middle tab in Rooms & Bookings. Campaigns has Templates (6 pre-built) and Audience (8 segments) tabs. Fixed bug where preferences/notes data type mismatch caused TypeError - frontend now handles both old (dict/string) and new (array) formats.

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real backend endpoints
